sources.name: Kontramarka Berlin
sources.note: Dense Russian-interface concert/theatre/comedy supply; event language requires its own proof. Specific event pages give year and local time.

sources.name: Rausgegangen Berlin
sources.note: Current city selections and many independent venues. Relative today/tomorrow labels must be anchored to retrieval date; distinguish admission, sold-out, door price and lottery.

sources.name: Berlin.de events
sources.note: Monthly dated highlights, festivals, free events and linked tickets. A monthly heading does not establish year for every card: October page also exposed a 2027 trade-show card.

sources.name: visitBerlin calendar
sources.note: Broad category/district/date filters; exhibitions and multi-year attractions coexist with single performances. Do not turn a displayed search-range boundary into the original event start.

sources.name: Berliner Philharmoniker calendar
sources.note: Calendar landing opened; individual in-window performances were not audited. Parent concerts page and official news are readable. Include guest-event and cancellation checks.

sources.name: Jazzfest Berlin 2026
sources.note: Search index gives 29 Oct–1 Nov 2026; direct open timed out. Berlin.de separately confirms dates. Do not claim direct first-party body retrieval.

sources.name: Berlin Events
sources.note: Preview contains actual Russian-language event text, with older September/October posts. Search mirror was fresher than direct preview. No in-window post permalink promoted to event proof.

sources.name: Svoi.Berlin
sources.note: Public group title and description exist; messages were not readable. /s/ preview returned a retrieval error. Do not count profile existence as event coverage.

sources.name: Svoi.Berlin Instagram
sources.note: Profile URL is explicitly linked in Svoi.Berlin public Telegram description. Direct Instagram open returned Internal Error; no event post verified.

sources.name: The Strokes Berlin concert discussion
sources.note: Exact dated October 15 concert discussion is readable. Secondary community lead, not organizer authority or ticket availability.

note: Discovery, access checks and imported records are separate. No source parser or automatic refresh is implied.
